title: MCP server command runs unpinned third-party npm package with agent privileges
detail: Every agent-harness MCP startup resolves and executes the latest registry version of a third-party package with full user privileges and project write access. The wired server is documented as experimental and fast-moving, so registry/package compromise means arbitrary code at agent boot.
recommended_fix: Pin an exact version (args ["-y", "ue-mcp@<x.y.z>", ...]) and note the pin+upgrade procedure in docs/agent-playbook.md; or vendor a lockfile-verified install.

title: Playbook security rules omit same-host browser origin threat to unauthenticated editor bridge
evidence:
`.mcp.json` retries the bridge (`ws://127.0.0.1:9877`) in the background —
...
- Both servers are **loopback-only / unauthenticated** — never expose the
  port, never run them on a shared machine, never forward.
detail: The write-capable unauthenticated bridge listens on a loopback WebSocket; browser pages can open cross-origin connections to localhost WebSockets. The official server rejects non-loopback Origin (research-report.md:83), but the wired bridge's Origin validation is undocumented.
recommended_fix: Verify the ue-mcp bridge's Origin handling in its source/docs; document it in the playbook Security rules and add guidance to stop the bridge while browsing untrusted sites.

title: Committed HTML report loads CDN scripts without Subresource Integrity
detail: The committed artifact pulls executable JavaScript (and CSS) from a third-party CDN with no integrity hashes; a CDN or package compromise runs script in the reader's browser whenever the report is opened.
recommended_fix: Add integrity="sha384-..." crossorigin attributes to the CDN tags (mermaid import at line 341 too), or vendor the assets beside the artifact.
